questions.stem: What is the final remnant of a high-mass star after a supernova explosion?

options.text: A white dwarf or planetary nebula
A neutron star or black hole

questions.explanation: After a high-mass star explodes as a supernova, the remaining core collapses to form either a neutron star (if the core is below about 3 solar masses) or a black hole (if the core exceeds this limit).
